record.body:
## Evidence

orchestra/conductor/suite.py builds FAST_SUITE_CMD && TMUX_SUITE_CMD. The second leg exits 5. tests/test_tiered_verification.py pins the stale shape.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix work-item fix-review-findings changes the fallback, README, and test together.
